procedure.step: The factory must complete Factory Registration through the Ministry of Economy and Tourism prior to applying for a preferential certificate of origin.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: The exporter or local manufacturer applies for the Certificate of Origin for India via the Ministry of Foreign Trade e-services portal by uploading the required commercial and factory documents.
The Ministry of Foreign Trade charges a certificate fee ranging from AED 10 to AED 200 depending on the invoice value.
The competent authority issues the Certificate of Origin prior to, at, or within 5 working days of export; the certificate remains valid for 12 months for a single import.

The Indian importer claims the CEPA rate when filing the bill of entry, holds origin documentation under CAROTAR 2020, and responds to customs inquiries within 10 working days; electronic certificates are reportedly accepted and uploaded to e-Sanchit (unconfirmed).
The exporter must maintain all origin documentation and detailed cost sheets for at least 5 years from the end of the calendar year of certificate issuance.

caveats.note: No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.
'+' in a rule is read as 'and' (both tests must pass). The agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.
CEPA rates reduce Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only. IGST, GST compensation cess, SWS and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.
The CEPA rate applies only if the product qualifies under the rules of origin and a valid certificate of origin is presented.

A producer in a free zone is likely not eligible for Factory Registration, because it requires a factory outside a free zone, and registration is needed before applying for the certificate of origin for India.
A product that only undergoes minimal operations (such as simple cutting or simple assembly) does not originate, even if it meets its product-specific rule.
